about: Follow-up 2 to STORY-009: context-aware matching. Fixed on 2026-09-24 BEFORE any round-3 held-out case was written. Only what is listed here may be built; a rule added or changed after the follow-up-2 pilot run does not count toward a pass.

context_rule.summary: Judge only log lines that show something going wrong.
context_rule.line_level: The first of INFO / WARN / WARNING / ERROR / FATAL appearing as a whole word in the line; a line with none counts as INFO.

counts.WARN / WARNING: only if the line says something was killed, terminated, lost, exited or evicted (whole words, case-insensitive), or contains ExecutorLostFailure or OOMKilled

context_rule.winner: Unchanged: the category with the most counted matching lines wins; none counted means 'uncertain'.
context_rule.designed_against: The 26 already-seen cases only. On them it fixes holdout-013 and changes no other verdict.

wording_additions.source: Linux kernel OOM killer. Added after seeing holdout-008, so that case passing is not evidence.
HDFS and storage quotas, words allowed in between. Added after seeing holdout-014, so that case passing is not evidence.

pass_rule: Unchanged: overall error rate <= 5% and every case within 3600 s. The user chose the 5% limit alone. The round-3 held-out error count (the only truly unseen cases) is always reported separately, but it is not an extra pass condition.
